description: This file defines the AgentService class, which implements a core agent loop for a reactive AI system. It manages chat interactions, tools, execution flow, and exception handling within a Flutter application context.

classes.name: AgentErrorType
classes.description: Enumeration of possible error types within the agent system.

classes.name: AgentException
classes.description: Custom exception class for agent-related errors, providing descriptive messages.

classes.name: AgentService
classes.description: Main class implementing the reactive agent loop, managing chat, tools, and execution state.

methods.name: setApiKey
methods.description: Sets the API key to switch between live and mock chat modes.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the agent's message history, steps, and running state.

methods.name: runAgent
methods.description: Main method to run the agent loop, processing user input and managing interactions.

methods.name: _addStep
methods.description: Adds a step of a given type to the internal steps list and notifies listeners.

methods.name: _setupTools
methods.description: Initializes available tools for the agent like read_file, write_to_file, get_current_time, and calculate.

methods.name: _evaluateExpression
methods.description: Evaluates a mathematical expression string into a numeric result.

methods.name: _pE
methods.description: Parses addition and subtraction in expression tokens.

methods.name: _pT
methods.description: Parses multiplication and division in expression tokens.

methods.name: _executeAction
methods.description: Executes a string-formatted action by calling the appropriate tool.

methods.name: _parseAction
methods.description: Parses an action string into tool name and arguments.

methods.name: _parseArguments
methods.description: Parses argument list string into individual arguments.

methods.name: _extractContent
methods.description: Extracts content enclosed within specific XML-like tags from text.

methods.name: _generateSystemPrompt
methods.description: Generates the system prompt string used in initial message for the agent.
